Method of Attack: Remote access backdoor capable of taking complete control of the compromised system
Delivered via specially-crafted Microsoft Word documents exploiting Integer Overflow bug in OLE file format and Microsoft Office Equation Editor vulnerability
Attack Vector: Specially-crafted Microsoft Word documents exploiting Integer Overflow bug in OLE file format
Chaining with Microsoft Office Equation Editor exploit
Use of accounts with administrative user rights
Indicators of Compromise: OLE Integer Overflow bug in Microsoft Office Word
Proof-of-concept provided to Microsoft Security Response Center (MSRC) Case 45367
